questions.question: What complaint opens Psalm 10?
options: Why do the righteous suffer while the wicked thrive?
Why does the LORD stand far off and hide in trouble?
Why has the LORD forgotten his covenant?
Why have the nations risen up against Zion?
questions.answer: Why does the LORD stand far off and hide in trouble?

questions.question: What does the wicked say in his heart?
options: 'Into your hand I commit my spirit'
'Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me'
'The LORD is my light and my salvation'
'God has forgotten, he will never see it'
questions.answer: 'God has forgotten, he will never see it'
